Platform Process Guide
Applicant provider and admin demonstration with account labelled walkthroughs
Use this guide to demonstrate the actual applicant action, the responsible provider or admin action, and the
resulting handoff. Start with the live demonstration order below, then use the 42 process sections for the detailed
controls and screenshots. Inspect first and save a decision only when you intend to change that record. Show
manager and superadmin views last.
Use Orivanta Open Learning Grant for a new application. The other published programs have closed intakes and
prepared selection or support records. The same four applicants have records in several scholarships, so always
check both the applicant name and the program. Use Orivanta Academic Merit Scholarship for DSS, Continuing
Learners Grant for agreement and document review, Term Assistance Grant for receipt and renewal, and School
Essentials Award for one-time support.
Updated November 18 2026 Philippine time for final provider agreement and onboarding. The initial hosted
demonstration reset used Orivanta Learning Foundation and the accounts listed here. Additional tester-created
records may now exist and have not been removed. Hosting and local databases are not identical. Existing hosted
offers remain unchanged; the new required-onboarding path applies only when the requirement was disclosed in a
new intake before applications.
The onboarding setting screenshot was captured from hosting on November 18. Required-path screenshots are
labelled isolated local previews because existing hosted offers have no recorded onboarding requirement. Earlier
screenshots remain where the process is unchanged. Capture did not save a hosted decision, response, receipt or
payment. Recheck the named program and its current state before repeating a step.
The 28 curated logins listed here currently use password123. This does not describe passwords on tester-created
accounts. Use only the supplied sample documents and fictional payout details. New receipt confirmations require
an applicant attachment. Never make a real transfer or checkout merely to demonstrate a button, and never use
shared demonstration credentials for a real launch.
Recommended live demonstration order
Open https://findscholarship.online. Use separate browser profiles or different browsers for applicant, provider
and admin; ordinary tabs in one profile share the same login. For a single browser profile, sign out before switching
roles. Have sample JPG, PNG and PDF documents ready from D:\Document Requirements. Acknowledge alerts only
after reading the affected record and outcome.
1. Profile and verification: learner.profile completes its own record. lumenops.reviews opens learner.verification,
reviews individual files and academic results, then records the separate final profile result. These are different
prepared accounts, not an automatically synchronized profile demonstration.
2. Program and publication: orivanta.programs opens the draft Digital Learning Grant and demonstrates the staged
form and modals. lumenops.reviews inspects the pending College Pathways Award through Open details, then
confirms the intended publication outcome. Do not publish or alter a different program accidentally.
3. Application: learner.aurora opens the accepting Open Learning Grant, reads How to apply and Eligibility, selects
current documents and confirms a new application. This is a fresh tester action, not one of the 25 existing
application records.

4. Screening and formal verification: orivanta.reviewer uses Aurora in Campus Access. orivanta.selection uses Brio
in that same program for formal verification. Check the exact scholarship when changing accounts.
5. Scheduled selection: use Applied Science for exams and Leadership for interviews. Aurora has a conducted stage
for an outcome; Brio or Cielo covers assignment or acknowledgement; Dune covers the exam-session completion
starting point. Record attendance, provider proof and required evaluation before the individual outcome.
6. DSS and final decision: orivanta.selection completes the three missing interview criteria for Dune in Academic
Merit. orivanta.decisions reloads the four-candidate comparison with two slots and inspects stage and criterion
breakdowns before confirming an outcome. No separate award amount is entered here.
7. Offer response: learner.aurora opens Continuing Learners Grant and chooses Review and respond. Explain
Confirm intention versus the separate final provider agreement. This legacy offer does not acquire a new
agreement requirement. For a newly configured required-onboarding intake, continue with the provider and
applicant steps in Section 19.
8. Recurring support: learner.cielo views the upcoming Term Assistance handoff. orivanta.monitoring reviews the
attended Continuing Learners handoff for Cielo or closes the ready case for Dune. Use originals at the appointment,
not applicant uploads as substitutes for these checks.
9. Release and receipt: orivanta.releases reviews Dune payout details or records a scheduled distribution. Aurora in
Term Assistance and Cielo in School Essentials can demonstrate receipt confirmation with required applicant proof.
Brio in Term Assistance is the settled recurring-support example for the recipient officer.
10. One-time completion: orivanta.recipients opens Dune in School Essentials, reviews its already-settled benefit
and records the intended completion. Show the applicant saved outcome afterward. No recurring semester plan is
needed for this one-time award.
11. Admin and service handoffs: show orivanta.support and lumenops.support, the Account Manager referral,
provider service delivery through orivanta.billing and lumenops.billing, the Finance return through
lumenops.finance, then history through lumenops.records. Create a handoff only when its real prerequisite exists;
do not make an actual payment.
12. Combined views last: orivanta.manager and orivanta show organization-wide provider access.
lumenops.manager shows read-only portal oversight; lumenops.root handles admin-team governance. Do not use
these views to imply that every specialist decision is an oversight action.
Optional branches include eligibility reconsideration, correction requests, delivery disputes, withdrawal, agreement
concerns and appeals. Read their prerequisites before starting. Required notice and reminder periods cannot be
compressed into a few minutes by backdating records. Demonstrating the available form is not the same as
completing that branch.

2 Applicant profile and supporting evidence
Signed in account: learner.aurora
Page shown: Applicant profile
The applicant record is the main profile content. Personal and contact, education, household and location
information is grouped so reviewers and applicants can scan the same record. Use section edit modals rather than

Edit the applicant information in its modal
Signed in account: learner.profile
1. Choose Edit profile or the relevant section Edit action. Open the information group you need; do not try to
complete every part in one sitting.
2. Update only the affected details. For an address, use the separate address fields and a selectable map pin on land
in the Philippines. Check the actual populated region, province, city and barangay before saving.
3. Follow the guardian requirement shown for the applicant age. For an adult, provide guardian details when the
provider requests them rather than inventing a guardian. Review the confirmation before Save changes; Cancel
leaves unsaved text unchanged.

4. Photo changes can save immediately through the photo controls, so do not replace or remove a photo merely to
demonstrate the form.
Inspect the profile edit modal without saving
Signed in account: learner.profile
Open only the information group that needs editing. This screen shows the same applicant record structure used
for review; saving profile text is not evidence verification.
1. Choose Edit profile and inspect the personal and contact fields. Use the relevant group for education household
or location rather than opening another full page.
2. Use Cancel to close without saving. Reopen only when you intend to make a real change. Photo controls may
save immediately and should not be clicked just to test cancellation.

3 Admin applicant verification
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
Page shown: Admin applicant review
The review officer checks supporting files first. In the academic record review, Academic results contains the
grading scale and verified result; accepting that document saves any correction. Step 2 then records only the overall
profile outcome and review note. Accepting evidence does not verify the whole profile or select an applicant for a
scholarship. Use learner.verification for this queue and lumenops.reviews to review it.

Applicant: learner.verification supplies or corrects evidence. Provider: cannot replace platform profile verification
with a scholarship decision. Admin: lumenops.reviews performs verification; superadmin is not the normal
operational reviewer.
Open the applicant verification record
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
1. Select Applicant Verification from Applicant verification. Confirm the name and account before reviewing.
2. Read the review guide for the current step. Expand the complete profile only when more context is needed, and
check any changes since the previous decision.
3. Go to Supporting evidence and compare each required document with the corresponding declared information.
4. Uploaded files do not verify the whole profile. Review current evidence first; use the queue navigation to keep
the original search and filters while opening the next record.

Review an individual supporting document
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
1. Select Review beside a submitted document to open this evidence-review dialog.
2. Inspect the file and related self-declared profile details. OCR is only a suggestion; use the larger preview if
needed.
3. For an academic record, choose Accept document and confirm or correct the grading scale and verified result in
Academic results. For an unreadable or unsuitable file, request a replacement and explain why.

4. Acknowledge the comparison, then accept the document to save the academic result and evidence decision
together. This leaves overall profile verification pending.
Record overall profile verification
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
1. Return to the applicant record after reviewing the individual files and photo.
2. At Step 2 Final profile decision, confirm that all current required evidence is accepted. Grades were already

3. Choose Verify profile, Request profile correction, or Keep under review for the profile as a whole. Add the final

4. Save decision records only the overall profile outcome, not grades or a scholarship result. An outdated form is

again.

Review organization documents individually
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
1. Sign in as lumenops.reviews, open Provider verification and select Orivanta Learning Foundation. Read its saved
approval and individual proof history. To demonstrate a fresh review, first deliberately reopen the appropriate
review or replace evidence through its actual workflow; do this only after the operational demonstration if it would
block provider access.

2. Choose Review on one file. Compare the submitted proof with the legal organization name, registration authority
and number, and representative details. Download it if the format cannot be previewed.
3. Choose Accept document only after inspecting it and checking the comparison acknowledgement. Otherwise
choose Request replacement and explain what must be corrected. Saving records the reviewer, time, note and file
revision; it does not verify the account.
4. In a fresh review, repeat for each current file. Unreviewed, unavailable and replacement-requested evidence
blocks approval. Reload if another reviewer or upload changes the record. Do not resave an existing approval
merely to make a demonstration look complete.

Record the final provider account decision
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
1. In Step 2 Final provider account decision, confirm all current proof has been individually accepted. Uploading
documents alone is insufficient.
2. Choose Approve, Reject, or Return to pending. Rejection requires a clear organization review note. File outcomes
and their notes remain independent.
3. Save decision only when appropriate. If the organization or document set changed, reload and inspect the
current record before deciding.
4. The hosted provider is already approved. This section explains the review workflow without changing that status.
Reopening verification or replacing required proof can affect operational access; finish the other provider
demonstrations first. Scholarship publication and applicant selection remain separate decisions.

Replace organization proof after a review
Signed in account: orivanta.profile
1. Open Organization profile then Legal verification. Review the status and corrective note for the affected file.
2. Choose the Replace document icon on that row. The upload form identifies the file being replaced and selects its

3. Upload proof replaces the old file with a new unreviewed record. The new file does not inherit acceptance. Other
unchanged accepted files keep their own decisions.
4. New proof or relevant legal identity changes return approved accounts to review. Relevant organization changes
invalidate prior file comparisons; a reviewer must inspect the current details and files again.

Configure documents and the formal application handoff
Signed in account: orivanta.programs

2. Configure the pre-screening files, optional files and post-qualification requirements appropriate to the program.

Allow eligibility reconsideration for chosen rules
Signed in account: orivanta.programs

All ten prepared programs currently have reconsideration turned off. This is an opt-in program policy not a general
bypass for every failed rule. Demonstrate configuration on the draft Digital Learning Grant first.
1. Open Eligibility and scroll to Eligibility reconsideration. Select only required criteria the provider is willing to
reconsider. Leave truly mandatory rules unchecked.
2. Review and save the draft. Relevant changes to a published program require publication review again; do not
change the active cohort policy silently.
3. For a live applicant request the resulting program must be published and accepting applications with capacity.
The applicant must have a complete verified profile and a real confirmed mismatch in an allowed rule.
4. Profile verification required files deadlines and intake limits cannot be waived through reconsideration. If the
prerequisites are not ready show the configuration only rather than inventing a request.

Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
Page shown: Admin program review
Program review uses a compact review record. Its readiness checks and publication outcome stay on the main
page; Open details and the individual information rows open a sectioned modal. Inspect the offer there, then
return to the separate publication decision. Organization approval and applicant verification are not publication

Inspect the submitted scholarship before publication
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews
1. Open a program from Program review and confirm its provider and submission status.
2. Choose Open details, or select the specific information row, to inspect overview, benefits, eligibility,
requirements, dates, selection and offer expectations in the modal. Closing the modal records no decision.
3. Back on the main record, read readiness checks and changes since the previous review. Choose the appropriate

4. Choose Save decision, inspect the confirmation and confirm only the intended outcome. If the submission
changed, reload and review it again. Publication makes the scholarship available; it does not select any applicant.

Define qualifications and the scoring plan
Signed in account: orivanta.programs
Use Orivanta Digital Learning Grant for program-builder changes. The six improvements preserve the existing
workflow: save and leave protection, rule-based eligibility wording, guided options, organization-location reuse,
clear DSS weights, and an actual-value final Review step.

1. In Eligibility, open the relevant option-picker modal and choose the intended education level, grade or year,
course or strand, school type and locations. Selected choices stay grouped in their field. Changing an education
level warns before clearing known incompatible choices; review retained custom entries before saving.
2. Keep required rules separate from preferred rules. Required confirmed mismatches block a new application
unless the provider has explicitly enabled and approved reconsideration for every blocking rule. Preferences do not
need an exception. Use the separate Eligibility reconsideration controls only for rules the provider is genuinely
willing to reconsider.
3. In Selection, inspect the actual DSS contribution of screening, exam and interview. Eligibility, document
completeness and formal verification are qualifying checks, not additional competitive points. First application
submission fixes the intake policy; do not change a scored intake to rewrite earlier applications.
4. In Review, inspect branding, benefits, intake capacity, dates, address fields and map pin, contact details,
eligibility, document lists, selection stages, scoring basis and offer expectations. Use Minimum average or Minimum
GWA / GPA according to the selected scale. A past date cannot be used to create a new schedule or program cycle;
do not backdate records to unlock a demonstration.
5. Save the draft or submit after resolving the existing readiness checks and accepting the provider declaration.
Save status distinguishes unsaved, saving, saved and failed changes. The leave confirmation protects unsaved edits.
Publication remains a separate admin decision; a completed section is not an approval.
Expected result and handoff: The published program supplies clear rules and a stable evaluation basis. The admin
reviewer checks publication readiness separately from applicant selection.
Open program information in the review modal
Signed in account: lumenops.reviews

1. Choose Open details or a specific information row. Navigate the modal sections to inspect what applicants would

8 Scholarship discovery and preparation
Signed in account: learner.aurora
Page shown: Applicant scholarships
Search published scholarships and open View details to read the offer, benefits, eligibility, file requirements,
instructions and application deadline. Result cards use the separate scholarship logo, not the cover photo. A
verified profile is required to apply. A required mismatch remains blocking unless an authorized provider approves
an allowed reconsideration request; preferences and eligibility matching percentages are not selection outcomes.

Current hosted view | learner.aurora | applicant scholarships
Applicant: learner.aurora is ready to start a new application. Provider: supplies accurate program and organization
content. Admin: oversees publication and trust checks, not the applicant choice of scholarship.
Submit a new scholarship application
Signed in account: learner.aurora
Use the open Orivanta Open Learning Grant. The account already has a verified profile; completing an application is
a new tester action.
1. Open Scholarships, select View details, then read How to apply, Eligibility, Requirements and the deadline. A
suggested match percentage is preparation guidance, not approval.
2. Choose Apply. Review the current profile and eligibility checks. Use the eligibility link for details; do not proceed
by entering a false value to satisfy a rule.
3. If a confirmed required rule does not match, open Eligibility. Request eligibility review appears only when the
provider permits reconsideration for all blocking rules and the verified profile, open intake and other safeguards
allow it. Submit an explanation and optional supporting picture or document, then wait. Do not change accurate
profile data just to make a match.
4. Choose current files from My Documents or upload the required files. These prepared programs have no short
application questions. Accept the required declarations and terms before submission; the question feature remains
available for other programs.
5. Review the complete application and confirm submission. Open Applications afterward and inspect the saved
requirements, current stage and next-action guidance.

Expected result and handoff: A submitted application appears in the provider review queue. It is not yet screened,
selected, accepted for support or paid.
Request eligibility review before applying
Signed in account: Applicant with a verified profile then orivanta.reviewer
This optional branch requires a published open program with provider-enabled reconsideration. It is not a pending
request in the prepared dataset. Never falsify the applicant profile to create a match or a mismatch.
1. In scholarship details open Eligibility. If every confirmed blocking rule permits reconsideration choose Request
eligibility review.
2. Explain the circumstances in 20 to 2000 characters. Optionally attach one JPG PNG WebP or PDF up to 5 MB.
Unlike receipt confirmation this eligibility attachment is optional.
3. Acknowledge accurate information review the confirmation and send the request. It does not submit an
application reserve a slot or select the applicant.
4. Read the provider response in the same Eligibility section and use Refresh status. Approval permits applying only
for the reviewed profile rules and intake; relevant changes require a fresh review.
5. Continue to the normal application only after approval and all other safeguards are met. The original mismatch
and provider exception remain visible in the saved comparison.

Demonstration boundaries
This guide targets hosting at findscholarship.online. Local data uses earlier accounts and is not the same dataset.
The guide update made no database reset or business decision. Treat the recorded starting states as a November
16 snapshot, preserve tester actions, and use another appropriate prepared record when repeating a branch.
Shared passwords and sample evidence are not for a real launch.
A term-related early support termination requires its separate guarded decision and the appeal opportunity. Do not
backdate records or change the clock to bypass it. Independent review and delivery receipt are separate actions.
Cross-provider disclosure remains disabled.
No failure, rejection, termination, official waitlist, missed collection or unclaimed outcome is required merely to
follow the main walkthrough. Concern, withdrawal, appeal and internal admin handoff branches may need the
tester to create their real prerequisite. Eligibility review is implemented but is off on all ten prepared programs until
deliberately enabled. The prepared organization is approved; additional tester-created accounts are outside this
route.
Demonstration completion checklist
• Applicant verification is separate from scholarship screening and publication. Show the document review action
before the overall verification result.
• A published session has a real roster, attendance, proof and individual result. A DSS suggestion remains
advisory until the decision officer confirms the outcome.
• Selected applicants confirm intention, not a signed final contract. For a new required-onboarding intake, show
the disclosed requirement, provider instructions, applicant Requirements card and provider-confirmed
completion before actual distribution. Existing offers are not retroactively opted in. Appointments, original-
document checks and check-in closure remain separate.
• Benefit delivery needs provider evidence and a separate applicant receipt response with its own required
private proof. An issue report is not a receipt confirmation. One-time awards need no artificial recurring
monitoring plan; unsettled promised benefits still block normal completion.
• Support, Account Manager, Billing and Finance each return their own handoff. An internal reply does not
silently perform another team decision.
• Finish with manager ownership views and superadmin role coverage. Preserve the tester decisions and use a
fresh prepared starting point when demonstrating another branch.
